sections.shortTitle: Reserve Bank of India Closing of Annual Accounts Act 1940
sections.description:
Short title and extent

The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940
The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940.
Received the assent
of the Governor General on the 1 1 th March,' 1940. and is published in the
Gazette of India, dated the 16th March, 1940.
Act No. VII of
1940.
An Act to facilitate the changing of the date on
which the annual aceonrts of the Reserve Bank of India are closed.
1. Short title and extent -(1)
This Act may be called the Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts)
Act, 1940,
(2) It extends to the whole of
British India.
Notes.
Object.--"The accounts -of the Reserve Bank of India are at
present closed on the 31st December each year., As this date coincides with the
height of the busy season, the Reserve Banl; expe-iences considerable
difficulty in closing its accounts and in preparing its annual report for
submission to the shareholders within six weeks as prescribed in section.14-of
the Reserve_Bank of India Act. The Reserve Bank has therefore requested
Government to introduce the necessary legislation to enable it to.close-its
accounts on the 30th June of each year." ( Vide Statement of Objects and.
Reasons, printed : at page 96 of Part V of the Gazette of India, dated the l7th
February 1946.)

sections.shortTitle: Reserve Bank of India Closing of Annual Accounts Act 1940
sections.description:
Power to close accounts at expiry of period of six months

The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940
The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940.
Received the assent
of the Governor General on the 1 1 th March,' 1940. and is published in the
Gazette of India, dated the 16th March, 1940.
Act No. VII of
1940.
An Act to facilitate the changing of the date on
which the annual aceonrts of the Reserve Bank of India are closed.
3. Power to close accounts at
expiry of period of six months.-Not-withstanding anything to the contrary
contained. in the . Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, or the regulations made
under section 58 thereof the Bank may, for the purpose of facilitating that
changing of the date on which the annual accounts of the Bank are -closed,
close its accounts as at the close of business on the 30th day of June, 1940;
and convene a general meeting (which shall be an annual general meeting within
the meaning of the, said Act) at -a place where there is an office of the Bank
within six weeks from the date on which the accounts are closed Provided that
this general meeting. shall not he held. at the same place as that at which the
immediately preceding annual general meeting was -held.

sections.shortTitle: Reserve Bank of India Closing of Annual Accounts Act 1940
sections.description:
Application of Act 11 of 1934 when accounts ore closed under section 3

The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940
The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940.
Received the assent
of the Governor General on the 1 1 th March,' 1940. and is published in the
Gazette of India, dated the 16th March, 1940.
Act No. VII of
1940.
An Act to facilitate the changing of the date on
which the annual aceonrts of the Reserve Bank of India are closed.
4. Application of Act 11 of
1934 when accounts ore closed under section 3.---References in sub-section
(21 of section 14, section 52 and sub sections (2) and (3j of section 53 of the
Reserve. Bank of India Act, 1934, to annual accounts, annual balance-sheet, the
auditors' report upon the annual balance-sheet and accounts, and the report of
the Central Board on the work ing of the Bank throughout the year, shall be deemed
to include references to the accounts, balance-sheet, auditors' report and the
report of the Central Board in respect of a period of six months ending on the
30th day of June, 1940.

sections.shortTitle: Reserve Bank of India Closing of Annual Accounts Act 1940
sections.description:
Interpretation of section 47, Act II of 1934

The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940
The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940.
Received the assent
of the Governor General on the 1 1 th March,' 1940. and is published in the
Gazette of India, dated the 16th March, 1940.
Act No. VII of
1940.
An Act to facilitate the changing of the date on
which the annual aceonrts of the Reserve Bank of India are closed.
5. Interpretation of section
47, Act II of 1934.-For the purposes of section 47 of the Reserve Bank of
India Act, 1934, the net profits of the Bank for the period of six months
ending on the 30th day of June, 1940, shall be deemed to be. "net annual
profits" but the cumulative _ dividend referred to in that section as
payable out of such profits shall be payable at the rate of one and three
quarter per cent.

sections.shortTitle: Reserve Bank of India Closing of Annual Accounts Act 1940
sections.description:
Power to make regulations

The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940
The Reserve Bank of India (Closing of Annual Accounts) Act, 1940.
Received the assent
of the Governor General on the 1 1 th March,' 1940. and is published in the
Gazette of India, dated the 16th March, 1940.
Act No. VII of
1940.
An Act to facilitate the changing of the date on
which the annual aceonrts of the Reserve Bank of India are closed.
6. Power to make regulations. The
Central Board of Directors of the Bank may, with the previous sanction of the
Central Government, make regu lations to provide for any matter for which
provision is necessary or convenient in connection with the changing of the
date on which the annual accounts of the Bank are closed, and in particular and
without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing power for the manner in which
the amount, if any, of the additional dividend referred to in section 47 of the
Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, shall be calculated in respect of the period
of six months ending on the 30th day of June, 1940.
